ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black) distribution across the visible fluke plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white regions in distal and mid-lobe areas; low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated at the peduncle junction and extending along the leading edges; small circular dark focal point on the mid-right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at the central axis with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern; higher amplitude indentations on the right lobe trailing edge compared to the left; pixel variations indicate moderate roughness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-intensity, high-relief pixels indicating barnacle encrustation on the distal tip of the left lobe; small dark circular pixel ring on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, dark linear pixel strings oriented near-vertically on the mid-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced calcified mass on the far-left tip; distinct circular scar on the right lobe; yellowish biological staining/pigmentation localized near the inner right median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique yellowish-brown pigmentation patch on the lower inner portion of the right lobe, diverging from the primary black/white palette.
